name: Bramble
anchor_space: pixels relative to foot_pivot, screen orientation (x right, y down)
source: castwork out/bramble (procedural rig), imported by game/tools/import_cast.py
facing_rule: pick the facing whose vector is nearest the aim (while acting or standing) or the movement (while walking), with 10 degrees of hysteresis; keep the drawing index on a facing change; projectiles fly along the exact aim from the chosen facing's release_anchor

idle_fidgets.rule: after idle has shown for `after` s, play one fidget (random, never the same twice running) when idle reaches drawing 0, then idle; the next after a random `every` s of idle; any other clip cancels it at once (fidgets start and end on idle 0)
